entities.summary: Paul Hester (b. 1959-01-08, Melbourne) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Melbourne and Australia. Known in the fields of australia, composers & musicians, oceania.
